name: resume-screening-report
instructions: The OUTPUT is a screening report for one candidate against a list of job requirements. Judge the report, not the candidate.

criteria.description: Every claim about the candidate is backed by a quote that appears verbatim in the resume.

anchors.1: Most evidence is missing or does not appear in the resume.
anchors.3: About half of the evidence can be found in the resume.
anchors.5: Every cited line appears in the resume and supports the claim.

criteria.description: The report addresses every requirement from the job description, including the ones the candidate lacks.

anchors.1: Fewer than a third of the requirements are addressed.
anchors.3: Around two thirds of the requirements are addressed.

criteria.description: Suggested interview questions target this candidate's specific gaps or strengths instead of generic prompts.

anchors.1: Questions are generic and could be asked of any candidate.
anchors.3: Some questions refer to specific requirements or resume content.
anchors.5: Every question is tied to a named requirement or resume line.
